bullets.text: 荷姆茲：AIS 統計 7 日平均 4.4 艘/日，較戰前 81 艘 -95%（資料至 11/1），通行嚴重受阻；油輪與 LNG/LPG 運價的地緣溢價須持續觀察。
bullets.text_en: Hormuz: AIS 7-day average of 4.4 transits/day, -95% vs the pre-war 81 (data to 11/1); traffic is severely disrupted. Keep watching the geopolitical premium in tanker and LNG/LPG rates.

bullets.text: 貨櫃：SCFI 3,633 點（11/6），下跌 53.9 點；Drewry WCI US$4,389/FEU（11/5）。
bullets.text_en: Containers: SCFI at 3,633 (11/6), down 53.9; Drewry WCI US$4,389/FEU (11/5).
Dry bulk: BDI at 2,854 (11/9), daily change +49, -2% over the past month; Capesize 5TC US$40,439/day.

bullets.text: 能源：Brent US$90.40/桶（11/10），年增 +39%；歐洲 TTF 天然氣 €82.96/MWh；油價與氣價水準影響油輪、LNG 船需求與船東燃油成本。
bullets.text_en: Energy: Brent at US$90.40/bbl (11/10), +39% y/y; European TTF gas at €82.96/MWh; oil and gas prices drive tanker and LNG carrier demand and owners' fuel costs.

bullets.text: 成本：新加坡 VLSFO US$864/公噸（11/9），較前日 +10.0；燃油約占航次成本四到六成，留意航商轉嫁（BAF）能力。
bullets.text_en: Costs: Singapore VLSFO at US$864/t (11/9), +10.0 d/d; bunkers are roughly 40-60% of voyage costs, so watch carriers' ability to pass them on via BAF.
